purpose: Preserve fixed-endpoint signed-S evidence after a campaign-budget termination; not a successful replacement of the frozen600s/600s parent experiment.

parent.terminal_condition: Parent process/queue job is terminal, final summary exists, and its terminal_negative_reason explicitly identifies the frozen campaign-wall budget. A technical/backend/input failure does not activate this proposal.
parent.skip_condition: If both fixed parent endpoints already have complete finite DEV per-case metrics, do not launch or reread this conditional stage; report the parent evidence and its retained negative campaign gate.

eligibility.local: Committed training_summary.json complete=true, offset=0, steps=3*pass_index, equal per-case updates, training_seconds>=600, first_gradient.passed=true, matching last.pt and parent contract.
eligibility.global: A nonempty, finite, committed last.pt exists at parent termination and matches the parent arm/contract. Missing, corrupt or nonfinite checkpoint is terminal negative; no fallback to an earlier checkpoint.

endpoint_selection.rule: For each arm select exactly the last successfully committed last.pt present when the parent terminal snapshot is frozen, before any additional prediction or DEV-label access. The complete local endpoint and global partial endpoint use the same last-committed rule.
endpoint_selection.snapshot: Freeze parent final-summary identity, arm training-summary/status identities, checkpoint path/stat/SHA256, common-initialization identity and parent scaler/input contract. Record an explicit selection timestamp and parent terminal evidence. Do not inspect live weights during design preparation.
endpoint_selection.checkpoint_actual_read_validation: At the later authorized readout, validate loaded config/arm and record saved state steps, pass_index, offset, case_updates, case_order_prefix, first_gradient and checkpoint training_seconds. Do not infer partial training from file names or journal alone.
training_disclosure: Model's committed steps, balanced passes, partial-pass offset and per-case exposure counts
Committed checkpoint training seconds separately from parent journal charged training seconds
Journal failed_actual_training_seconds and uncommitted/replayed-update disclosures when present
Parent campaign wall, inherited cost, overshoot/termination cause and missing parent metrics
forbidden: parent budget reset or parent gate rewrite

readout.scope: Only the two existing DEV/ver cases, complete original-node order. No new TRAIN predictions, additional CADs, dia, original archives, old final or sealed test.
readout.model: Reuse the frozen parent class, inputs, common initialization, exact selected weights and serialized normalizers. Global uses the same target-independent71-channel R64 frontend and16-channel query; local uses exact zero16 latent.
readout.prediction: Decode unrestricted signed scalar S to MPa with the serialized parent asinh inverse. Persist finite allN predictions and checkpoint identities for both arms and both DEV cases before any DEV label array read.
readout.U: Copy immutable original physical_u_mm bytes with identity proof only. No displacement target access, new U metrics, new physics solves or tensor recovery.
readout.barrier: Commit a new-stage barrier containing the four prediction metadata identities and the two selected checkpoint identities. Existing parent predictions may be reused only if their selected checkpoint identity is exactly the frozen selection; otherwise write new-stage predictions without overwriting the parent.
readout.labels: After the complete barrier, open each DEV original signed-S cached label once and share it across both arms. Prefer a verified committed parent evaluation-label copy if it exists; otherwise use the immutable accepted cached-original-S record. An uncommitted parent label attempt must be disclosed and handled explicitly, never silently counted as zero.
readout.label_receipt: New-stage GT_reads=2 and cached_signed_S_reads=2 on a clean actual evaluation, regardless of whether the verified copy is parent-owned or the accepted original-S cache. Distinguish source-cache reads from parent-owned-copy reads; original source stress-member reads=0, displacement reads=0. Actual attempted/completed reads and resumed owned-cache reads are separately preserved rather than forced to equal a nominal count.
readout.metrics: Per DEV case allN original signed-S relativeL2, RMSE/MAE/max in MPa, topceil1% by abs originalS hotspot L2 with stable row ties. Shared denominator2; zero reference gives null relative error and absolute metrics. Report mean/worst and per-case values for each fixed endpoint.

budget_and_outputs.budget_scope: New independent cumulative wall including imports, cache/checkpoint reads, frontend/H2D, complete prediction/decode/persistence, labels/metrics and report; resume never resets it. It does not modify or refill the parent1800s budget.
budget_and_outputs.new_costs: Actual new readout cost and phases are reported separately. Parent training/inherited costs remain context and are not relabeled as new costs or as fresh complete deployment measurement.
budget_and_outputs.incomplete: On missing endpoint, nonfinite prediction, incomplete four-prediction barrier or readout-budget stop, retain explicit null metrics/negative status; do not select another checkpoint or extend training.

interpretation.endpoint_signal: The original per-case25% S/hot thresholds and20% descriptive global-to-local mean difference may be tabulated as fixed-endpoint evidence only, with actual unequal training prominently attached. They cannot repair the parent completion gate, prove architecture superiority or choose a final solver.
interpretation.decision_use: If either endpoint has useful held-out-CAD signed-S predictions, root may design a new independently budgeted macro-validation stage. If neither is useful, close this representation; no automatic training, loss/width/seed rescue or sealed-test access.
interpretation.source_S_semantics: Original signed labels are unchanged. Exact source exporter/sign/recovery remains unknown; this readout does not identify it.

design_receipt.reads: Frozen source text and ready/plan small metadata only
